verifiedClaims.fact: Four named plaintiffs filed a class-action complaint against Anthropic, OpenAI OpCo, SpaceXAI and Google in the Northern District of California.
Plaintiffs allege an agreement among competitors to slow product improvement and an associated loss of subscription value; this remains an allegation.
The complaint says plaintiffs do not seek to prohibit defendants from independently adopting safety measures or independently slowing or suspending their own development.
The pleading proposes a class and requests certification, damages and injunctive relief; none is a court-granted outcome.
The complaint pleads a Sherman Act Section 1 claim and a separate request for injunctive relief under Clayton Act Section 16.
